gloss_en: baki — 'expert, proficient' (Hebrew בָּקִי): mastery/expertise, specifically the twofold expertise 'expert in running forward, expert in returning' (baki be-ratzo, baki be-shov), whose letters are homiletically identified with the Divine Name YB"K (gematria 112)

outliers.actual_gloss_en: gnats/mosquitoes (Aramaic baqei, plural of בָּקָא), which the ox swats away with its long tail in the Talmudic passage (Shabbat 77b) 'they dwell in marshes and need to swat gnats'
outliers.reason: Homograph: the quoted Aramaic word בָּקֵי means 'gnats,' not 'expert'; Rabbi Nachman links its letters to יב"ק by wordplay, but the underlying lexeme is a different word from Hebrew בָּקִי 'expert.'
